Package org.apache.juneau.console.bus

Class BusPolicy.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.bus.BusPolicy.Builder
Enclosing class:
BusPolicy
public static final class BusPolicy.Builder extends Object
Builder for BusPolicy.
Example:

BusPolicy p = BusPolicy.create() .downstream("ops.jobs", true) .sessionAttributes(req -> Map.of("region", req.getHeader("X-Region"))) .maxSessions(64) .build();

    • boundary

      public BusPolicy.Builder boundary(RequestBoundary value)
      Sets the request boundary. The session POST and SSE stream apply its check.

      The WebSocket handshake cannot run check, so it applies the boundary's own handshake rules: a LoopbackBoundary's exact origin() and authority(), or a CsrfBoundary's Origin match against the handshake's own Host and scheme. BusWebSockets.register refuses any other boundary type.

      Parameters:
      value - The boundary. Can be null.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • allowedOrigins

      public BusPolicy.Builder allowedOrigins(String... values)
      Sets the exact origins a WebSocket handshake may carry when no boundary is set. Ignored when a boundary is set.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      This object.
